WHAT WE KNOW
USGS gauge at this upstream site recorded pH = 7.6 on 2026-01-08 at 12:00.
WHY THE ESTIMATE IS WHAT IT IS
The observed pH of 7.6 suggests mildly alkaline conditions. Moving downstream, the river passes through sandstone terrain which tends to resist pH change (a process called buffering), so we expect pH to remain near 7.5-7.7 at this segment.
WHAT THE VALUE MEANS
A pH of 7.6 is slightly alkaline — similar to tap water in most cities. It is safe for most fish species and poses no immediate concern for human contact.
UNCERTAINTY & CONFIDENCE
We assigned a confidence level of 0.8 because we have real-time USGS observations, but the data is relatively consistent, with minor fluctuations over time. No nearby facilities or weather events significantly impact our estimate.
KEY TAKEAWAY
The river pH at this segment remains mildly alkaline, posing no immediate concerns for aquatic life or human contact.
